Russia and North Korea open first road bridge across border

Russia and North Korea have officially opened the first road bridge connecting their countries, according to state media reports. The bridge spans the Tumen River, which forms part of the border between the two nations. The opening ceremony was attended by officials from both countries. The development has raised concerns in Ukraine.
